title: Hover preview scope
question: Entity hover previews will use Honest Clubhouse shell (not the dark Linear look). Confirm where they should appear.

options.label: All organiser hub entity lists
options.thesis: Events, recurring, collections, forms, custom links—and dashboard Coming up / Top events rows that reuse the same event row.
options.viewport: Hover a row → floating preview above with richer meta; touch devices keep the compact row only.
options.risk: Dense dashboard panels need careful placement so the card is not clipped.

options.label: Catalogue pages only
options.thesis: Only full list pages (events dashboard, recurring, collections, forms, custom links)—skip compact dashboard widgets.
options.viewport: Full-width catalogue rows get previews; Coming up stays compact.
options.risk: Inconsistent: same event row behaves differently in two places.
